title: Cortisol and Adrenal Androgens as Predictors of Mortality in Septic Patients
author: Rocío e Castro
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ymxfu7n

steps.title: Confirm patient fasting
steps.instruction: Ensure each patient has abstained from food for at least 10 hours prior to blood collection.

steps.title: Schedule morning blood draw
steps.instruction: Perform blood sample collection between 08:00 a.m. and 09:00 a.m. for all participants.

steps.title: Collect blood into appropriate tubes
steps.instruction: Draw blood into silicone‑vacuum tubes containing a silica‑gel filter (no anticoagulant) for serum, and into a venous extraction syringe without a compressor; place the syringe sample on ice immediately for lactate analysis.

steps.title: Store and process samples
steps.instruction: Keep all collected samples at 0–12 °C before, during, and after extraction; process each sample within 1 hour of collection; allow serum tubes to clot for 20–30 min, then centrifuge at 2000 g at room temperature.

steps.title: Aliquot and freeze serum for hormones
steps.instruction: On the same day as extraction, perform general biochemical assays; aliquot serum intended for DHEA and DHEAS measurement into properly labeled cryotubes and freeze at –40 °C to –60 °C until further analysis.
